evidence.free_mcp: Hosted MCP access included with Public brokerage account at no extra cost.
evidence.live_market_data: Official MCP/API supports live market data during trading hours.
evidence.scheduler_callability: Hosted MCP URL https://mcp.public.com/mcp plus official Python SDK/MCP server; API supports automated/quant use.
evidence.account_read: Official MCP exposes balances, buying power, portfolio positions, orders and transactions.
evidence.quote_schema: Official quote API exposes last, lastTimestamp, bid, bidSize, bidTimestamp, ask, askSize, askTimestamp.
evidence.timestamp_semantics: Official SDK describes lastTimestamp as when last trade occurred; bidTimestamp/askTimestamp as when bid/ask were last updated.
evidence.personal_use: Individual API explicitly permits personal, non-commercial use.
evidence.market_data_contract: Public Market Data Addendum contains Nasdaq nonprofessional subscriber terms.
